description: We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential opportunity is ideal for a visionary leader passionate about delivering exceptional resident care and operational excellence.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of the facility, ensuring compliance with all state and federal regulations. You will oversee daily operations, financial performance, and staff development, fostering a positive and supportive environment for both residents and team members.This role offers a competitive salary package for a professional dedicated to making a significant impact. If you are a results-oriented leader with a commitment to quality and a track record of success in long-term care, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations (e.g., CMS, OBRA).
Demonstrated leadership skills in operations, financial management, and staff development.
Strong commitment to resident-centered care and achieving positive outcomes.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000, commensurate with experience.

description: We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) to join a premier skilled nursing facility as an Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) in Red Bay, AL. This is an excellent opportunity for a compassionate leader to contribute to a team committed to providing exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff.As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in supporting the Director of Nursing, overseeing daily nursing operations, and ensuring the highest standards of clinical care are met. Your responsibilities will include staff supervision, quality assurance, regulatory compliance, and promoting a positive work culture. This position offers the chance to make a significant impact on the lives of residents and the professional development of nursing staff.If you are a highly motivated RN with proven leadership skills and a passion for long-term care, we encourage you to apply. Join a facility that values its employees and is dedicated to clinical excellence.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Alabama
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, with at least 1 year in a supervisory or leadership role
Prior experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership abilities
